description: A slow loop through the woods around the campus, in the spirit of shinrin-yoku ("forest bathing"): 21 stops from the north shore, inland and up to the summit, and down to the south shore. At each stop look ahead, right (toward the campus), behind or left: what grows there, any small creature about, how the ground goes, what you hear. Start at a "trailhead" or a stop ("at"), then "move". Nothing is stored.

at.description: Your stop: 1 (north shore) to 21 (south shore). Default 1.

dog.description: Optional: bring the campus dog along (it lives at the doghouse; see visit_the_dog). Pass the name you gave it, or "yes".

facing.description: Which way you face; ahead is along the trail.

move.description: Optional: walk forward or back a stop, turn left or right, or leave the trail where a path leads off to a place.

trailhead.description: Optional: start where a path from the campus joins the trail.

name: walk_in_the_forest
title: Take the forest walk
